caseName: G. M. Leasing Corp. v. United States
caseNameFull: G. M. Leasing Corp. v. United States

opinions.text: C. A. 10th Cir. Certiorari granted limited to Question 2 presented by the petition which reads as follows: “Whether tax agents of the United States acted illegally in seizing automobiles and documents in violation of petitioner G. M. Leasing Corporation’s Fourth Amendment rights under the Constitution of the United States.”
